plain.li: [greetings,warm,house:known,!house:renowned] We have heard a little of your family, {WRITER}, and all of it good.
[greetings,cordial,house:known,!house:renowned,theirLowtech] Your family's name has reached us, {WRITER}. We are glad to put a hand to it.
[greetings,cordial,house:known,!house:renowned,theirHightech] Your family's name is {RENOWN}, we hear. Good to have a letter to go with it.
[greetings,warm,house:renowned,theirHightech] A letter from one of {HOUSE} is always welcome here.
[greetings,warm,house:renowned,theirLowtech] Your family's name is {RENOWN}, {WRITER}, and your letter is read with care.
[greetings,cordial,house:wide,theirLowtech] Your family's name is {RENOWN}, {WRITER}. We are glad of your letter.
[greetings,cordial,house:wide,theirHightech] Your family's name is {RENOWN}, so your letter was read first.
[greetings,cool,house:known] We know your family's name. We will see whether you live up to it.
[greetings,curt,house:renowned] Your family's name is known here. That earns you an answer, no more.
[greetings,warm,house:knownfor:hosts] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}, and we hope to see it for ourselves one day.
[greetings,warm,house:knownfor:healers,theirLowtech] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. Our sick speak of it with hope.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:healers,theirHightech] Your family's known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. Our medics would like to compare notes some time.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:fighters,theirHightech] Your family's known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. Good neighbors to have.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:traders,theirLowtech] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, and our traders would gladly deal with it.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:makers,theirHightech] Your family has a name for {KNOWNFOR}. Our buyers would like to know more.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:makers,theirLowtech] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. Our crafters would like to see it.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:faithful,theirHightech] Your family is known for {KNOWNFOR}, {WRITER}. We respect that, whatever we believe.
[greetings,cordial,house:knownfor:hosts,theirHightech] Your family has a name for {KNOWNFOR}, and your letter reads like it.
[greetings,cool,house:infamous,theirLowtech] We have your letter. Your family's name is {RENOWN}, and we will be careful.
[greetings,curt,house:infamous,theirHightech] Your letter came. Your family's name is {RENOWN}, so keep it brief.
[greetings,cordial,house:infamous] We have heard what is said of {HOUSE}. Your letter says something better, and we will remember it.
[news,warm,house:known] Here is our news, {WRITER}, and know that your family's name is {RENOWN}.
[news,cordial,house:knownfor:traders] Here is our news. Our traders will want to hear yours, from a family known for {KNOWNFOR}.
[warning,warm,house:renowned] A warning from one of {HOUSE} we take to heart. Thank you.
[warning,cordial,house:known] We have your warning, and your family's name gives it weight.
[warning,cool,house:infamous] We have your warning. From one of {HOUSE}, we will look into it ourselves.
[condolences,warm,house:renowned] Your letter means more coming from one of {HOUSE}. Thank you for thinking of us.
[condolences,cordial,house:known] Thank you for your words, {WRITER}. Your family's name is known here, and now so is its kindness.
[condolences,cool,house:infamous] We have your letter. Kind words from one of {HOUSE} were not what we expected.
[help,cordial,house:known] We can send {HELP}. Your family's name is known to us, and that counts for something.
[help,warm,house:wide] For a family whose name is {RENOWN}, {HELP} is the least we can send.
[help,refusal,house:renowned] Your family's name is known here, but we cannot spare {HELP} now.
[invitation,cordial,house:known] We would like to meet the family behind the name. We will come.
[invitation,warm,house:knownfor:hosts] A family known for {KNOWNFOR} has asked us to visit. We will come, and hungry.
[invitation,cool,house:known] We have your invitation. Your family's name is known here, but we will not travel now.
[greetings,warm,them:house] Our house is glad of your letter, {WRITER}.
[greetings,cordial,them:house,theirHightech] The family thanks you for writing. We keep our letters, and we will keep yours.
[greetings,cordial,them:house:renowned,theirHightech] Our family's name is well known here, and it is good to see your colony's on a letter.
[news,cordial,them:house] Here is our news, as our house hears it.
[greetings,cool,them:house:feud,!them:house] We have your letter. What lies between us and your colony is not settled by one.
[greetings,curt,them:house:feud,!them:house,theirLowtech] We have not forgotten what lies between us. Say what you came to say.
[greetings,curt,them:house:feud,!them:house,theirHightech] There is still a grudge against your colony here. Keep it short.
[greetings,cool,them:house:feud,them:house,theirHightech] My family still holds your colony to account. Your letter is noted.
[renownup,us,!house:renowned] Seems the next town has heard of our family.
[renownup,us,!house:renowned] Our name's going around nearby, apparently.
[renownup,us,tribal,!house:renowned] The nearest camp tells of our family at its fire now.
[renownup,us,tribal,!house:renowned] Our name has reached the next camp's fire before any of us did.
[renownup,us,medieval,!house:renowned] They say our name came up at the next town's market.
[renownup,us,medieval,!house:renowned] The next town knows our family's name now, I'm told.
[renownup,us,industrial,!house:renowned] People in the next town have started asking about our family.
[renownup,us,industrial,!house:renowned] Our family name gets mentioned in the next town now.
[renownup,us,spacer,!house:renowned] Our family name turned up on the nearest settlement's channel.
[renownup,us,spacer,!house:renowned] The nearest settlement has our family name in its feeds now.
[renownup,us,house:renowned,!house:wide] The whole region knows our family's name now.
[renownup,us,tribal,house:renowned,!house:wide] Every fire in the region tells of our family now, they say.
[renownup,us,medieval,house:renowned,!house:wide] Our family's name is sung in halls I've never set foot in.
[renownup,us,industrial,house:renowned,!house:wide] Our family's in the region's papers, apparently.
[renownup,us,spacer,house:renowned,!house:wide] Every channel in the region carries our family name now.
[renownup,us,house:wide] Strangers from every people around know our name now.
[renownup,us,tribal,house:wide] Clans we have never met tell of our family now.
[renownup,us,medieval,house:wide] They sing of our family in halls far and wide, I'm told.
[renownup,us,industrial,house:wide] Every people around seems to know our family's name now.
[renownup,us,spacer,house:wide] Our family name is out past every relay in reach.
[renownup,us,house:knownfor:healers] If we're known for our healing now, I hope the hurt know where to find us.
[renownup,us,house:knownfor:fighters] I'd rather be known for something besides fighting, but I'll take it.
[renownup,us,house:knownfor:hosts] Good, maybe more guests will come knocking.
[renownup,us,house:knownfor:traders] Being known for our trading is good for business.
[renownup,us,house:knownfor:makers] People know our family for its work, and the work is what matters.
[renownup,us,house:knownfor:faithful] I hope our faith is what they remember us by.
[renownup,us,kind] Let's give them good reasons to keep saying our name.
[renowndown,us,!house:wasrenowned] The next town has stopped talking about us, it seems.
[renowndown,us,tribal,!house:wasrenowned] The nearest camp tells other stories at its fire now.
[renowndown,us,medieval,!house:wasrenowned] Nobody at the next town's market speaks of us now.
[renowndown,us,industrial,!house:wasrenowned] The next town's found something else to talk about.
[renowndown,us,spacer,!house:wasrenowned] Our name's gone quiet on the nearest settlement's channels.
[renowndown,us,house:wasrenowned] For a while the whole region knew our name, and now nobody does.
[renowndown,us,tribal,house:wasrenowned] The fires of the region have forgotten our name for now.
[renowndown,us,medieval,house:wasrenowned] The halls sing of other families now.
[renowndown,us,industrial,house:wasrenowned] The papers have no more use for our family.
[renowndown,us,spacer,house:wasrenowned] The region's channels have moved on from us.
[renowndown,us] We'll just have to give them something new to talk about.
[renowndown,us,kind] Quiet suits us well enough.
[wordyes,them,house:known,!house:renowned] I've heard your family's name, so my word will land on good ground.
[wordyes,them,house:wide] Your family's name will do most of the work, I'll only add mine.
[wordyes,them,house:renowned,theirLowtech] Gladly, a word for a good name is easily given.
